name: pubmed-reader-cskill

metadata.description: PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv & medRxiv reader and literature explorer for scientists - search articles and preprints, read abstracts and full text, follow citations, find similar papers, and extract key information from biomedical literature and preprints using NCBI E-utilities, BioC PMC, arXiv, and bioRxiv/medRxiv APIs

plugins.name: pubmed-reader-plugin
plugins.description: PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv & medRxiv reader and literature explorer for scientists - search articles and preprints, read abstracts and full text, follow citations, find similar papers, and extract key information from biomedical literature and preprints using NCBI E-utilities, BioC PMC, arXiv, and bioRxiv/medRxiv APIs

when_to_use: User asks to search PubMed for articles on a topic
User mentions PMID or wants to read a specific article
User wants to find similar or related papers
User asks about citations or papers that cite a given article
User wants full text access for open access articles
User needs to explore biomedical literature systematically
User asks to summarize or extract information from papers
User asks to search arXiv for preprints
User mentions an arXiv ID or URL
User wants to read arXiv papers or preprints
User asks about papers in cs.CL, cs.AI, cs.LG, or other arXiv categories
User asks to search bioRxiv or medRxiv for preprints
User wants to read biology or medical preprints
User asks for recent preprints in biology or medicine
when_not_to_use: User asks about non-scientific topics unrelated to PubMed or arXiv
User wants to query gene/protein databases like UniProt or GeneCards
User asks for clinical trial data from ClinicalTrials.gov
User wants to access paywalled articles not in PMC Open Access

test_queries: Search PubMed for CRISPR gene editing 2024
Literature search for Alzheimer's disease biomarkers
Show me recent papers on mRNA vaccines
Explore citations for this cancer study PMID 20210808
Find related research on BRCA1 mutations
Find preprints about transformer architectures on arXiv
Get recent bioRxiv preprints on gene therapy
